aliagaAI.title: AliağaAI — Smart City Guide & Grounded RAG Assistant
aliagaAI.tagline: A zero-hallucination smart city assistant tailored for Aliağa, combining a React Native mobile client with a multi-stage hybrid RAG backend (FastAPI + pgvector + FTS).
aliagaAI.overview:
Built to overcome the fragmented, ad-heavy nature of generic search engines when citizens look for hyper-local municipal data such as on-duty pharmacies, İZBAN commuter schedules, utility outages, municipal announcements, and local directories.

AliağaAI pairs an agentic query router with a multi-stage grounded RAG pipeline so every response is backed by verified local sources with clickable [S1]/[S2] citations. On mobile, its black-and-gold Stitch Design System unifies live city status signals, interactive maps, and AI chat.
architectureSteps: Preprocessing & Agentic Query Router: Incoming user queries are normalized, analyzed for intent, and routed across structured SQL tables, live API caches (weather, earthquakes, pharmacies), or the semantic RAG pipeline.
Query Expansion & Hybrid Search: The pipeline generates 4 semantic query variants and executes pgvector HNSW cosine similarity search alongside PostgreSQL Turkish Full-Text Search (FTS) in parallel.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) & Reranking: Vector and lexical candidates are fused via RRF, filtered through dynamic similarity thresholds, and reranked for context precision.

Grounded LLM Synthesis & Isolated Scrapers: Groq Llama 3.3 synthesizes answers strictly from verified context with source citations, while 9 fault-isolated APScheduler bots continuously refresh city data in the background.
features: Agentic Query Router dynamically selecting between SQL, live city caches, and vector search
Hybrid retrieval combining pgvector HNSW embeddings, PostgreSQL FTS, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion
Clickable [S1], [S2] inline source citation chips inside mobile chat bubbles
Live city signal widgets for İZBAN trains, on-duty pharmacies, planned outages, local markets, and weather
9 fault-isolated asynchronous APScheduler data scrapers keeping local records up to date
Protected endpoints via X-API-Key authentication and SlowAPI IP rate limiting

aiDreamInterpreter.title: AI Dream Interpreter — Psychological Dream Analytics
aiDreamInterpreter.tagline: A psychological dream journaling and analysis platform grounded in Jungian archetypes and Freudian symbolism, powered by Gemini + Groq failover orchestration and symbol RAG.
aiDreamInterpreter.overview:
Unlike generic dream dictionaries, AI Dream Interpreter blends Carl Gustav Jung's collective unconscious/archetype theory and Sigmund Freud's symbolic analysis principles with modern multi-model LLM orchestration.

Instead of labeling dreams as merely good or bad, the platform extracts recurring symbols, emotional tone, and mental energy levels across your dream history to deliver personalized psychological insights and actionable daily reflections.
architectureSteps: Symbol Dictionary RAG Grounding: Concrete motifs and keywords in the user's dream journal entry are matched against a curated cultural and psychological symbol lexicon before prompting the model.
3-Stage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Pipeline: The model reasons through three structured stages—Detective (entity & action extraction), Analyst (Shadow, Anima, Persona archetype mapping), and Synthesis.
Multi-Provider LLM Failover: The Express/TypeScript backend calls Google Gemini 1.5 Flash as primary provider and seamlessly fails over to Groq Llama 3 upon rate limits or transient network errors.

Longitudinal Subconscious Analytics: Firestore-backed dream logs power a 0–100 mental energy gauge, 30-day sentiment & weekly activity charts, a monthly calendar heatmap, and top-recurring symbol rankings.
features: Selectable interpretation personas including rational clinical Analyst and warm practical Guide
High-availability multi-LLM orchestration with automatic Gemini 1.5 Flash to Groq Llama 3 failover
0–100 mental energy scoring, detected symbol cards, and single-sentence actionable daily insights
Weekly activity charts, monthly dream frequency heatmap, and recurring symbol analytics
Searchable dream archive with favorites and positive/neutral/negative sentiment filters
Firebase Auth security and GDPR/KVKK-compliant one-tap full account & data deletion

kayipQR.title: KayıpQR — Privacy-First Smart QR Tag Platform
kayipQR.tagline: Recover your belongings while keeping your phone number private. Customizable QR tags and accountless anonymous messaging between finders and owners.

highlights.label: PRIVACY MODEL
highlights.value: Zero Phone/Email Exposure & Accountless Finder Flow

highlights.label: QR DESIGN STUDIO
highlights.value: 8 Custom Themes, SVG/PNG & A4 Print Export

highlights.label: LEAN BACKEND
highlights.value: Redis-Free PostgreSQL Outbox, WebP & Rate Limits

kayipQR.overview:
Writing personal phone numbers on keychains, backpacks, laptops, or pet collars exposes owners to privacy risks. KayıpQR lets owners design and print custom QR stickers linked to a secure web relay: anyone who finds the item simply scans the QR code and sends a message—no app install and no sign-up required.

Engineered with a lean, serverless-ready PostgreSQL architecture that handles compressed WebP photo storage, shared rate-limit counters, and transactional email outbox queues directly in Postgres without requiring external Redis or S3 buckets.
architectureSteps: Dynamic Tag & Lifecycle Control: Owners toggle items between 'Safe', 'Lost', and 'Recovered' or pause public scanning anytime from their dashboard without invalidating the printed QR link.

Zero-Friction Finder Session: Scanning a tag opens a bilingual finder page supporting instant messaging, photo attachment, and optional location sharing via a private session link—never exposing the owner's email or phone.

Visibility-Aware Incremental Sync & WebSocket Option: Active chat tabs fetch incremental deltas and refresh signed media URLs efficiently on serverless deployments, with full WebSocket support for persistent hosts.

SQL Outbox & Anti-Spam Guardrails: First-contact Resend email notifications run through a reliable SQL outbox with daily retry jobs, protected by strict per-recipient rate limits (max 1 per 15m, 10 per 24h).
features: Interactive QR Design Studio with 8 templates, custom colors/labels, PNG/SVG export, and A4 print layouts
Accountless finder experience with photo uploads, optional location sharing, and private return-chat links
Strict privacy boundary ensuring phone numbers and account emails never appear in public API payloads
Argon2id password hashing, JWT authentication, and Alembic database migrations
Scan history logs, read receipts, and automated 30-day media retention cleanup
Automated test suite across Pytest (SQLite/PostgreSQL), pagination/polling tests, and GitHub Actions CI

weDo.title: WeDo — Shared Ideas, Lists & Decision App
weDo.tagline: Save what inspires you. Decide together. Make it happen. A mobile-first collaborative app for couples and friends to capture links from any app and turn them into real plans.

highlights.label: MOBILE CAPTURE
highlights.value: Native iOS & Android Share Sheet Integration

weDo.overview:
Great ideas—TikTok spots, Instagram Reels, products, movies, or restaurants—usually get buried across chat threads, browser tabs, and screenshots. WeDo turns 'should we do this?' into a structured collaborative workflow.

Users share any link, text, or image directly from their phone's native Share menu to WeDo. The backend automatically extracts rich titles and cover previews, drops the item into a shared space, and lets partners or friend groups react, organize into lists, schedule plans, and mark them complete.
architectureSteps: Native Share-to-Save Flow: Expo Share Intent captures URLs, text snippets, and images straight from Android and iOS system share sheets into the user's shared space.
Standards-Based Metadata Extraction: Prioritizes oEmbed for YouTube and TikTok, falling back to Open Graph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD parsers guarded by strict SSRF protection and payload size caps.
Modular Monolith FastAPI & PostgreSQL 17: Cleanly separated domain modules (auth, spaces, items, lists, metadata, uploads, background worker) built on Python 3.13, SQLAlchemy 2, and Alembic.
Hardened Auth & Containerized Stack: Implements Argon2 hashing, short-lived JWTs with refresh-token rotation, and auth rate limiting, orchestrated via Docker Compose and Nginx.
features: One-tap link, image, and text capture from Android and iOS native share menus
Automatic rich preview extraction across social video, shopping, travel, and content sites
Invite-based shared spaces and organized lists (Places to Go, Shopping, Watchlist, To-Do, custom)
Collaborative decision signals ('Both of you want this'), reactions, comments, and activity logs
Actionable plans, reminders, and background worker notification infrastructure
SSRF-protected metadata fetcher, Argon2 + rotating refresh tokens, and full Docker Compose setup

visualAI.title: Real-Time Visual Understanding — 100% Local Vision AI
visualAI.tagline: A privacy-first multimodal computer vision system that streams live webcam frames over WebSockets to a locally hosted Ollama LLaVA model for real-time natural language narration.

highlights.label: EXECUTION MODE
highlights.value: 100% Local GPU — Zero Cloud & Zero API Cost

visualAI.overview:
Cloud-based vision APIs introduce privacy concerns, per-request costs, and strict rate limits when analyzing continuous camera feeds. Real-Time Visual Understanding runs 100% locally on consumer GPUs so camera frames never leave the user's machine.

Live webcam frames captured in the browser are streamed over a persistent WebSocket connection to a FastAPI backend, processed by a 4-bit quantized LLaVA-7B vision-language model served via Ollama, and returned as live natural-language scene descriptions.
architectureSteps: Browser Frame Capture (React): Captures live webcam frames at controlled intervals and encodes lightweight Base64 payloads on the client.
Persistent WebSocket Transport: Streams frames over a full-duplex WebSocket channel between React and FastAPI, avoiding repetitive HTTP connection overhead.
FastAPI Frame Processor & Ollama Bridge: Validates incoming frames, manages backpressure, and dispatches multimodal prompts to the local Ollama runtime (localhost:11434).
Quantized Local GPU Inference: Runs llava:7b-v1.6-mistral-q4_0 efficiently on GPUs with 4GB+ VRAM, streaming scene narrations straight back to the UI.
features: 100% offline-capable local inference—camera footage never leaves your device
Unlimited continuous scene analysis with zero API fees and zero rate limits
Low-latency full-duplex WebSocket frame streaming and live response updates
Optimized 4-bit quantized LLaVA-7B Mistral model running smoothly on consumer GPUs
Clean, responsive web interface supporting both desktop and mobile browsers
